header.title: Conference Overview
header.subtitle: Two days of inspiring sessions and workshops
header.description: KovAI Conference 2025 features a comprehensive program with keynote presentations, panel discussions, technical sessions, and hands-on workshops. The agenda is designed to provide valuable insights and practical knowledge for professionals in manufacturing, healthcare, and textile industries.
